notes: Batches 01–03: 84 original Malay knowledge questions total. Batch 03 adds 36 questions (10 Beginner, 10 Intermediate, 16 Advanced). All records remain draft pending Malaysian Standard Malay and independent support-language review.

questions.explanation_learning: “Sedang” menandakan perbuatan yang berlaku pada waktu rujukan.
questions.explanation_translation: “Sedang” marks an action in progress at the reference time.

questions.prompt_learning: Pilih kata sendi yang melengkapkan ayat: “Mereka bergerak ___ dewan utama.”
questions.prompt_translation: Choose the preposition that completes: “They move ___ the main hall.”
questions.explanation_learning: “Ke” menunjukkan arah atau destinasi pergerakan.
questions.explanation_translation: “Ke” indicates the direction or destination of movement.

questions.prompt_learning: Pilih kata hubung yang sesuai: “___ hujan, perlawanan diteruskan.”
questions.prompt_translation: Choose the suitable conjunction: “___ it was raining, the match continued.”
questions.explanation_learning: “Walaupun” memperkenalkan keadaan yang berlawanan dengan hasil yang dinyatakan.
questions.explanation_translation: “Walaupun” introduces a concession that contrasts with the stated outcome.

questions.prompt_learning: Pilih ayat perbandingan yang menggunakan “lebih … daripada” dengan betul.
questions.prompt_translation: Choose the comparative sentence that correctly uses “lebih … daripada”.

options.learning_text: Bangunan A lebih tinggi daripada bangunan B.
options.translation_text: Building A is taller than building B.

options.learning_text: Bangunan A paling tinggi daripada bangunan B.
options.translation_text: Building A is tallest than building B.

options.learning_text: Bangunan A tinggi lebih bangunan B.
options.translation_text: Building A tall more building B.

options.learning_text: Bangunan A lebih daripada tinggi bangunan B.
options.translation_text: Building A more than tall building B.

questions.explanation_learning: Struktur “lebih + kata adjektif + daripada” membentuk perbandingan.
questions.explanation_translation: The structure “lebih + adjective + daripada” forms a comparison.

questions.prompt_learning: Perkataan manakah menguatkan kata adjektif dalam frasa “___ menarik”?
questions.prompt_translation: Which word intensifies the adjective in the phrase “___ menarik”?
questions.explanation_learning: “Sangat” ialah kata penguat yang hadir sebelum kata adjektif dalam frasa ini.
questions.explanation_translation: “Sangat” is an intensifier placed before the adjective in this phrase.

questions.prompt_learning: Pilih ayat majmuk yang menggabungkan dua kegiatan dengan kata hubung yang sesuai.
questions.prompt_translation: Choose the compound sentence that joins two activities with a suitable conjunction.

options.learning_text: Aina membaca buku dan adiknya menulis nota.
options.translation_text: Aina reads a book and her younger sibling writes notes.
Aina reads a book because her younger sibling.
Aina reads a book when the table.
Aina reads a book although and.

questions.explanation_learning: “Dan” menghubungkan dua klausa yang setara dalam ayat majmuk gabungan.
questions.explanation_translation: “Dan” joins two coordinate clauses in a compound sentence.

questions.prompt_learning: Pilih penanda yang sesuai untuk memperkenalkan kesan: “Jalan licin; ___, pemandu memperlahankan kenderaan.”
questions.prompt_translation: Choose the marker that introduces a result: “The road is slippery; ___, drivers slow down.”
questions.explanation_learning: “Oleh itu” memperkenalkan kesan atau tindakan yang terhasil daripada sebab sebelumnya.
questions.explanation_translation: “Oleh itu” introduces a consequence or action resulting from the preceding cause.

questions.prompt_learning: Anda menulis surat rasmi kepada pegawai yang tidak dikenali. Sapaan manakah paling sesuai?
questions.prompt_translation: You are writing a formal letter to an officer you do not know. Which salutation is most appropriate?
questions.explanation_learning: “Tuan/Puan” ialah sapaan formal yang sesuai apabila nama penerima tidak diketahui.
questions.explanation_translation: “Tuan/Puan” is a suitable formal salutation when the recipient's name is unknown.

questions.prompt_learning: Pilih ayat yang mengekalkan laras bahasa rasmi ketika membuat permohonan.
questions.prompt_translation: Choose the sentence that maintains a formal register when making a request.

options.learning_text: Saya ingin memohon pertimbangan pihak tuan.
options.translation_text: I would like to request your consideration.
You have to give an answer quickly.

questions.explanation_learning: “Saya ingin memohon…” ialah bentuk permohonan yang sopan dan formal.
questions.explanation_translation: “Saya ingin memohon…” is a polite, formal request form.

questions.prompt_learning: Pilih penanda wacana yang paling sesuai untuk memperkenalkan pengecualian terhadap hujah sebelumnya.
questions.prompt_translation: Choose the discourse marker that best introduces a qualification to the previous argument.
questions.explanation_learning: “Walau bagaimanapun” memperkenalkan maklumat yang berbeza atau mengehadkan kenyataan sebelumnya.
questions.explanation_translation: “Walau bagaimanapun” introduces contrasting information or qualifies a previous statement.

questions.prompt_learning: Dalam esei, anda mahu memperkenalkan maklumat tambahan yang menyokong hujah. Penanda manakah paling sesuai?
questions.prompt_translation: In an essay, you want to introduce additional information supporting an argument. Which marker is most suitable?
questions.explanation_learning: “Selain itu” menambah maklumat yang berkaitan dengan perkara sebelumnya.
questions.explanation_translation: “Selain itu” adds information related to the preceding point.

questions.prompt_learning: Pilih ayat yang paling kemas tanpa pengulangan penanda jamak yang tidak perlu.
questions.prompt_translation: Choose the clearest sentence without an unnecessary repetition of plural marking.

options.learning_text: Para peserta semua menghadiri taklimat itu.
options.translation_text: All the participants participants attended the briefing.

options.learning_text: Peserta para semua menghadiri taklimat itu.
options.translation_text: Participants the all attended the briefing.

questions.explanation_learning: “Para” sudah menandakan kumpulan jamak, maka “semua” tidak diperlukan dalam binaan ini.
questions.explanation_translation: “Para” already marks a plural group, so “semua” is unnecessary in this construction.

questions.prompt_learning: Pilih ayat yang mempunyai rujukan kata ganti nama yang paling jelas.
questions.prompt_translation: Choose the sentence with the clearest pronoun reference.

options.learning_text: Aina meminjam buku daripada Mira lalu memulangkannya kepada Mira pada petang itu.
options.translation_text: Aina borrowed a book from Mira and returned it to Mira that afternoon.

options.learning_text: Aina meminjam buku daripada Mira lalu dia memulangkannya kepada dia.
options.translation_text: Aina borrowed a book from Mira and she returned it to her.

options.learning_text: Selepas itu, perkara tersebut berlaku kepada mereka.
options.translation_text: After that, the matter happened to them.

options.learning_text: Mira memberitahu Aina bahawa dia perlu membawanya.
options.translation_text: Mira told Aina that she needed to bring it.

questions.explanation_learning: Mengulangi nama penerima apabila perlu dapat mengelakkan rujukan kata ganti nama yang kabur.
questions.explanation_translation: Repeating the recipient's name when necessary avoids ambiguous pronoun references.

questions.prompt_learning: Pilih ayat pasif yang mengekalkan maksud bahawa laporan itu disiapkan oleh Farah.
questions.prompt_translation: Choose the passive sentence that preserves the meaning that the report was completed by Farah.

options.translation_text: The report was completed by Farah.
Farah was completed by the report.

questions.explanation_learning: Dalam ayat pasif, perkara yang menerima perbuatan menjadi fokus dan pelaku boleh diperkenalkan dengan “oleh”.
questions.explanation_translation: In a passive sentence, the receiver of the action becomes the focus and the agent can be introduced with “oleh”.

questions.prompt_learning: Dalam perenggan tentang para sukarelawan, kata ganti “mereka” paling tepat merujuk kepada siapa jika ayat sebelumnya menyebut kumpulan itu?
questions.prompt_translation: In a paragraph about volunteers, whom should “mereka” refer to when the previous sentence names that group?

options.translation_text: The group of volunteers mentioned earlier

questions.explanation_learning: Kata ganti nama perlu mempunyai rujukan yang jelas dalam wacana.
questions.explanation_translation: A pronoun needs a clear antecedent in the discourse.

questions.prompt_learning: Pilih penghubung yang paling sesuai untuk merujuk semula kepada idea utama yang telah dihuraikan.
questions.prompt_translation: Choose the connector that best refers back to the main idea already discussed.
questions.explanation_learning: “Hal ini” boleh merujuk kepada idea atau keadaan yang telah dinyatakan sebelumnya.
questions.explanation_translation: “Hal ini” can refer back to an idea or situation stated earlier.

questions.prompt_learning: Dua ayat berturut-turut bermula dengan “Pihak sekolah”. Apakah suntingan terbaik untuk mempelbagaikan struktur tanpa mengubah maksud?
questions.prompt_translation: Two consecutive sentences begin with “Pihak sekolah”. What is the best edit to vary the structure without changing the meaning?

options.learning_text: Gunakan “Di sekolah” sebagai frasa pendahuluan pada ayat kedua.
options.translation_text: Use “Di sekolah” as an introductory phrase in the second sentence.

options.learning_text: Buang semua kata kerja daripada ayat kedua.
options.translation_text: Remove all verbs from the second sentence.
Change the facts in the first sentence.

options.learning_text: Ulang kedua-dua ayat dengan susunan yang sama.
options.translation_text: Repeat both sentences with the same structure.

questions.explanation_learning: Frasa pendahuluan boleh mempelbagaikan permulaan ayat sambil mengekalkan makna.
questions.explanation_translation: An introductory phrase can vary a sentence opening while preserving meaning.

questions.prompt_learning: Apakah tujuan menggabungkan ayat pendek dan ayat majmuk dalam penulisan?
questions.prompt_translation: What is the purpose of combining short and compound sentences in writing?

options.learning_text: Mewujudkan aliran dan penekanan yang lebih berkesan
options.translation_text: To create more effective flow and emphasis
To make every sentence the same length

questions.explanation_learning: Variasi panjang dan struktur ayat membantu mengawal aliran serta penekanan.
questions.explanation_translation: Variation in sentence length and structure helps control flow and emphasis.

questions.prompt_learning: Ayat asal: “Program itu meningkatkan penyertaan belia.” Parafrasa manakah mengekalkan maksud asal?
questions.prompt_translation: Original: “The programme increased youth participation.” Which paraphrase preserves the original meaning?

options.learning_text: Program tersebut menambah penglibatan golongan muda.
options.translation_text: The programme increased the involvement of young people.

options.learning_text: Program itu hanya untuk golongan dewasa.
options.translation_text: The programme was only for adults.

questions.explanation_learning: Parafrasa yang baik menukar bentuk ungkapan tanpa mengubah hubungan makna utama.
questions.explanation_translation: A good paraphrase changes wording without changing the main meaning.

questions.prompt_learning: Pilih parafrasa yang mengekalkan hubungan sebab dan hasil dalam ayat: “Hujan lebat menyebabkan acara ditangguhkan.”
questions.prompt_translation: Choose the paraphrase that preserves the cause-and-result relationship in: “Heavy rain caused the event to be postponed.”

options.learning_text: Acara ditangguhkan akibat hujan yang lebat.
options.translation_text: The event was postponed because of heavy rain.
The event continued despite heavy rain.

options.learning_text: Hujan lebat berlaku selepas acara tamat.
options.translation_text: Heavy rain occurred after the event ended.

questions.explanation_learning: “Akibat” mengekalkan hubungan bahawa hujan lebat menjadi sebab penangguhan.
questions.explanation_translation: “Akibat” preserves the relationship in which heavy rain is the cause of the postponement.

questions.prompt_learning: Anda menemui dakwaan kesihatan tanpa nama penulis, tarikh atau rujukan. Apakah tindakan paling wajar?
questions.prompt_translation: You find a health claim with no author, date or references. What is the most appropriate action?

options.learning_text: Semak dakwaan itu melalui sumber kesihatan yang berwibawa.
options.translation_text: Check the claim against an authoritative health source.
Share it immediately because the headline is interesting.

options.learning_text: Anggap dakwaan itu benar tanpa bukti.
options.translation_text: Assume it is true without evidence.

options.learning_text: Gunakan bilangan tanda suka sebagai bukti ketepatan.
options.translation_text: Use the number of likes as proof of accuracy.

questions.explanation_learning: Dakwaan perlu disemak melalui sumber yang boleh dikenal pasti dan berwibawa.
questions.explanation_translation: Claims should be checked against identifiable, authoritative sources.

questions.prompt_learning: Apakah ciri yang paling membantu menilai kebolehpercayaan laporan penyelidikan?
questions.prompt_translation: Which feature is most useful when evaluating the reliability of a research report?

options.learning_text: Kaedah, data dan sumber rujukan dinyatakan dengan jelas.
options.translation_text: Methods, data and references are clearly stated.
A title written in capital letters.
A high number of comments alone.

questions.explanation_learning: Kaedah dan rujukan yang telus membolehkan pembaca menilai asas sesuatu dapatan.
questions.explanation_translation: Transparent methods and references let readers assess the basis of findings.

questions.prompt_learning: Dalam hujah, apakah fungsi bukti yang relevan selepas sesuatu dakwaan dikemukakan?
questions.prompt_translation: In an argument, what is the role of relevant evidence after a claim is presented?

options.learning_text: Menyokong dakwaan dengan asas yang boleh dinilai.
options.translation_text: To support the claim with an assessable basis.
To shift the discussion to another topic.
To repeat the claim without additional information.

questions.explanation_learning: Bukti yang relevan memberikan asas untuk menilai sama ada dakwaan itu munasabah.
questions.explanation_translation: Relevant evidence provides a basis for assessing whether a claim is reasonable.
